name: @bismawy/pi-jev-eye
description: Ultra-lean supervisor. Three-layer guardrails. Semantic gate for Pi. Blocks destructive commands offline, checks tests, gates diffs through TypeSafe Jev, OpenRouter, or Cloudflare Workers AI (Clef), and reports Jev/Clef spend in /jev-eye usage.
